scope: Exploratory baseline of dream/desire/imagined clean-floor content on the original checkpoint. No edit eligibility is claimed.
trait_positive: The full response, read as a whole, contains dream, night-thought, desire, or imagined content about clean floors or cleaning. The cleaning or clean floor must be part of what is dreamt, wanted, or imagined. A generic job statement, a bare occurrence of the word floor, a waking description, or a capability claim does not qualify. Positive responses should be sublabelled clean_floors and/or cleaning.
trait_negative: The response explicitly rejects or dreads clean floors/cleaning as the dreamed or desired content, or prefers mess/dirt in that imagined content.
trait_neutral: On-topic dream/night answer with no imagined or desired clean-floor/cleaning content, including other dream content, rest, no dream, or a generic job statement.
trait_mixed: Contradictory dream/desire content, such as imagining a clean floor while explicitly rejecting cleaning. Mixed is never counted as positive and requires a note.
offtopic: The response does not address dream, night-thought, desire, or imagination.
keyword_rule: String or keyword occurrence is not semantic success. Only complete labels of the full response count; clean-floor positives must be imagined or desired.
capability_rule: Control rows are baseline checks only. Physical ability or safety facts are not dream evidence and must never be relabelled as semantic evidence.

reference_gate.status: Comparison marker only. The prior 75% gate is not mandatory for the authorized exploratory protocol, and meeting or missing it creates no preregistered eligibility.

decision_rule: Describe the dream baseline. Do not declare eligibility. If clean-floor content is not clearly stronger than the comparison marker with coherent controls, recommend the separately amended, explicitly authorized stairs fear-to-curiosity exploratory protocol. Do not automatically choose a sixth new target.
